name: ANNIE
summary: ANNIE measures neutrons released in accelerator-neutrino interactions on water and tests advanced optical neutrino-detector technology in Fermilab's Booster beam.
physics_targets: Final-state neutron multiplicity in neutrino-oxygen interactions
Nuclear effects and energy reconstruction in oscillation experiments
Gadolinium-water, LAPPD and water-based liquid-scintillator detector development
detection_principle: Prompt Cherenkov light identifies the charged lepton, while delayed neutron capture on gadolinium produces detectable gamma cascades. A downstream muon range detector measures escaping muons; picosecond photosensors improve vertex and track reconstruction.
